Feedback:

  • Need to post a synthesis of survey data - create a short presentation with your 5 biggest insights/takeaways (not just surface level observation, need to read between the lines and form connections). 
  • Review the decoding interviews presentation from the HCD studio. Begin transcription and analysis of completed interviews. 
  • By Friday: should have analysis completed and evidence pointing towards a rough direction / definition of your final device - list criteria, design principles, what should the device achieve? As well as context for use, and a more defined end user.
